note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands have no permanent population: those there are the Government's officers, the British Antarctic Survey's staff, visitors and fishing crews, each on a permit. Read on laws.gov.gs (the Government of SGSSI's laws), 2026-10-31. Majority: the Falkland Islands' Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance 1977, in the copy the SGSSI laws site holds as applied to the then Dependencies by the Application of Colony Laws Ordinance 1977 (file 1977-14 ... ACLO-1977), s. 3: an adult is a person who has attained eighteen, and an infant or minor one who hasn't; that it still applies in SGSSI, and that this makes full age eighteen, is my reading (later amendments, as the 2005 amending ordinance, weren't read). Work: the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Ordinance 1967 and an Employment of Children chapter are on the site, the latter a scanned image not read; with no resident population no rule for a child employed there was established, so work is null. Service: no law of military or national service was found among the territory's laws, so service is none (a reading from absence).
